name: Maer

attributes.attribute: a minor Irish heroine who dabbled in the occult arts
bewitched nine nuts to draw the hero Fionn mac Cumhaill to her bed
the hero who suspected the gift and did not eat the nuts

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Maer was an Irish heroine. She dabbled in the occult arts. She bewitched nine nuts so that the hero Fionn mac Cumhaill would come to her bed when he ate them. Fionn suspected the curious gift. He did not eat the nuts, and so he thwarted Maer's plot.
objective: Document Maer, the minor Irish heroine who bewitched nine nuts.
key_results: Record her use of the occult arts.
Record the bewitched nine nuts and the plot against Fionn mac Cumhaill.
Record Fionn's suspicion that thwarted her.
